recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for core reconciliation. issue_request: FHIR-3970 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 change request asking that extension definitions not inherit base Extension descriptive content such as aliases or comments when the extension definition does not declare them; the example also appeared to omit the USLabSpecimenRejectReason value set binding.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 4542, now git commit 3683b5294b18890b25b2311a3b0b947061ac145d, which changed ProfileUtilities to clear inherited descriptive fields for Extension derivations before overlaying derived extension content.
additional_context: The cited US Lab extension is not active core source in the current build: the old uslab IG entry is commented out, current core source grep found no USLabSpecimenRejectReason or specimen-reject-reason artifact, and the successor Specimen Reject Reason extension lives in the FHIR Extension Pack. The extension-pack differential supplies the binding and does not declare inherited alias/comment elements, and a current build.fhir.org JSON check shows no alias/comment on Extension with the value[x] binding present. FHIR-3971 used the same example but concerns hyperlink presentation, so it was not decided here.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current core repository already lacks the stale artifact and the current external artifact no longer shows the inherited alias/comment or missing-binding symptom described by FHIR-3970.
